api_version: KNMI EDR v1, collection hourly-in-situ-meteorological-observations-validated; station/time coverage and wind parameters to be pinned

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only, no automatic source request or caller-selected path, unbounded domain, secrets, crawler, bulk extraction or retries. Metadata path(s) are only candidate exact origins; actual provider GET requires independently reviewed provider machine-use terms, exact URL, byte cap, body hash and source-specific approved workflow.

response_contract.format: OGC EDR versioned collection metadata and eventual bounded station/time CoverageJSON only after registered credential and exact product rights review; no original readings requested.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Validated hourly in-situ observations are distinct from 10-minute near-real-time data and modeled WINS50. Need original parameter-name, height, gust definition, UTC intervals, station relocation/QC and collection vintage before independent ERA5 challenge.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: KNMI describes 200 requests/second and 1,000 requests/hour for registered EDR keys; use lower scoped budgets after commercial use and permission review, never assume a key exists.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Collection coverage and station parameters vary; v1 path must remain versioned and original timestamps/metadata pinned.

rights_and_policy.notes: KNMI provides documented data-platform API and validates-hourly collection; exact collection's licence, attribution, restrictions on commercial automated insurance use and raw redistribution remain unreviewed. A separate EDR API key is required; Open Data API keys are NOT interchangeable.

notes: Blocked: no connected KNMI EDR account or original authenticated request receipt, response body or source-native sample. Never put tokens into repository, logs or prompts. Registered rate limits documented but are not a commercial-use right.
